concerns.external_issuance_constraint: GitHub credential is issued outside repository state; plaintext readback is impossible and forbidden.
concerns.exposure_boundary: GitHub Governance hosted-state on accepted main only; never pull_request code.

stages.issue_or_import: Issue a least-privilege replacement credential outside Git and keep the previous credential valid.
stages.validate: Validate intended Administration/Secrets/Environments read permissions by successful metadata-only governance and credential audit calls.
stages.bind: Write-only bind the replacement to repository secret GOVERNANCE_AUDIT_TOKEN through the protected GitHub secret API/operator ceremony.
stages.switch: Accepted-main hosted governance begins consuming the replacement repository binding.
stages.verify: Require successful live governance plus metadata-only credential reconciliation from accepted main.
stages.revoke_previous: Revoke the previous issuer-side credential only after replacement verification succeeds.

concerns.recovery: If verification fails, keep or restore the still-valid previous issuer credential and repeat validation before revocation.

concerns.external_issuance_constraint: The privileged bootstrap credential cannot depend on repository code to issue or recover itself; external GitHub administrator ceremony remains the root recovery path.
concerns.exposure_boundary: Accepted-main hosted credential reconciliation only; secret is never exposed to pull_request jobs.

stages.issue_or_import: Issue a replacement privileged operator credential through an external GitHub administrator ceremony while the previous bootstrap path remains available.
stages.validate: Validate repository administration plus Secrets/Environments metadata permissions without mutating repository or environment secrets.
stages.bind: Write-only bind the replacement to repository secret GH_ADMIN_OPERATOR_TOKEN outside pull_request execution.
stages.switch: Accepted-main hosted reconciliation starts using the replacement operator binding.
stages.verify: Require successful repository and environment secret-name metadata reconciliation from accepted main.
stages.revoke_previous: Revoke the previous external operator credential only after the accepted-main replacement proves usable.

concerns.recovery: Use the external administrator bootstrap path to restore a known-good operator credential; never attempt self-repair from untrusted PR code.

concerns.external_issuance_constraint: Cloudflare issues the API token; its plaintext is shown only at issuance and must be transferred directly into protected GitHub Environment storage.
concerns.exposure_boundary: Protected staging/production GitHub Environment jobs; AR-8C live acceptance uses read-only staging audit only.

stages.issue_or_import: Issue a least-privilege replacement Cloudflare API token while the previous token remains valid.
stages.validate: Verify the replacement token reports active through GET /user/tokens/verify and validate required provider permissions without deployment mutation.
stages.bind: Write-only bind the replacement to CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN in the intended protected GitHub Environment.
stages.switch: The existing protected promotion executor consumes the replacement environment binding on the next authorized operation.
stages.verify: Require active token status and successful read-only staging provider preflight before any previous-token revocation.
stages.revoke_previous: Revoke the previous Cloudflare token only after replacement verification and environment cutover evidence are complete.

concerns.recovery: Retain the previous token until verification completes; on failure restore the previous GitHub binding or issue a fresh replacement before revocation.

concerns.external_issuance_constraint: Cloudflare Access issues the service-token pair; both protected components must be treated as one logical credential concern.
concerns.exposure_boundary: Protected staging/production promotion jobs only; never repository plaintext or pull_request code.

stages.issue_or_import: Issue a replacement Access service token while the previous pair remains valid where provider semantics permit overlap.
stages.validate: Validate replacement identity and intended Access scope without changing production deployment state.
stages.bind: Write-only bind client id and client secret together to the target protected GitHub Environment.
stages.switch: The existing promotion/smoke executor uses the replacement pair for protected endpoint access.
stages.verify: Require successful Access-authenticated health smoke in an authorized non-production rehearsal/staging path before retirement.
stages.revoke_previous: Revoke the previous Access service token pair only after replacement smoke verification succeeds.

concerns.recovery: Keep the previous pair valid through verification; if the replacement fails, restore the prior protected binding and reissue deliberately.

concerns.exposure_boundary: Protected GitHub Environment input consumed only by the existing accepted-main promotion executor.

stages.issue_or_import: Assemble the protected transport bundle from credentials owned by their existing AR-8A/D/E authorities outside repository plaintext.
stages.validate: Require the exact resolver secret-name set and fail closed on missing, extra, placeholder or malformed protected input.
stages.bind: Write-only bind the validated bundle to CLOUDFLARE_RESOLVER_SECRETS_JSON in the target protected GitHub Environment.
stages.switch: The existing promotion workflow materializes the bundle only into a mode-0600 temporary file and passes it to pinned Wrangler deployment.
stages.verify: Require Wrangler dry-run/deploy required-secret validation plus metadata-only promotion evidence.
stages.revoke_previous: No independent credential is revoked at the transport layer; underlying credential owners perform their own revoke-previous lifecycle.

concerns.recovery: Rebind a previously validated transport bundle only while its underlying credentials remain valid; otherwise rebuild from owning authorities.

concerns.exposure_boundary: Protected GitHub Environment input consumed only by the existing accepted-main promotion executor.

stages.issue_or_import: Assemble the protected control-plane transport bundle from credentials owned by their existing AR-8C/D authorities outside repository plaintext.
stages.validate: Require the exact control-plane secret-name set and fail closed on missing, extra, placeholder or malformed protected input.
stages.bind: Write-only bind the validated bundle to CLOUDFLARE_CONTROL_PLANE_SECRETS_JSON in the target protected GitHub Environment.
stages.switch: The existing promotion workflow materializes the bundle only into a mode-0600 temporary file and passes it to pinned Wrangler deployment.
stages.verify: Require Wrangler dry-run/deploy required-secret validation plus metadata-only promotion evidence.
stages.revoke_previous: No independent credential is revoked at the transport layer; underlying credential owners perform their own revoke-previous lifecycle.

concerns.recovery: Rebind a previously validated transport bundle only while its underlying credentials remain valid; otherwise rebuild from owning authorities.

concerns.exposure_boundary: Protected GitHub Environment configuration input; never a credential authority and never pull_request plaintext.

stages.issue_or_import: Prepare canonical environment deployment identity/configuration outside repository-sensitive state.
stages.validate: Validate strict environment identity, resource identifiers and exact immutable release/promotion expectations.
stages.bind: Write-only bind protected configuration to CLOUDFLARE_DEPLOY_MANIFEST_JSON in the target GitHub Environment.
stages.switch: The existing promotion workflow renders no-rebuild Wrangler configs from the validated protected manifest.
stages.verify: Require exact-source preflight, remote read checks and metadata-only promotion evidence.
stages.revoke_previous: No credential revocation applies; replace prior protected configuration only through the same validated binding ceremony.

concerns.recovery: Restore the last validated environment manifest if compatible with the accepted immutable release; otherwise fail closed and prepare a corrected manifest.

concerns.external_issuance_constraint: R2 access credentials are provider-issued; the pair must be transferred through protected control-plane transport and never stored in repository plaintext.
concerns.exposure_boundary: Protected control-plane bundle and Cloudflare Worker secret store through the existing promotion executor.

stages.issue_or_import: Issue a replacement bounded R2 credential pair while the previous pair remains valid.
stages.validate: Validate replacement access against the intended account/bucket with least privilege before cutover.
stages.bind: Place the replacement pair into the protected control-plane bundle for the target environment.
stages.switch: The existing promotion workflow updates Worker secrets through pinned Wrangler as part of the accepted deployment path.
stages.verify: Require required-secret validation and bounded staging profile-generation object access before prior credential retirement.
stages.revoke_previous: Revoke the previous R2 credential pair only after the replacement Worker binding and bounded access are verified.

concerns.recovery: Keep the previous pair valid until replacement verification; on failure restore the prior protected bundle/binding or issue a new replacement.
